acceptance.given: A Replay Result has succeeded and its bound target, validator capability, dependencies, command, Probe, output, Consumer, snapshot, and non-authority inputs are available for independent checking.

oracle.expected: The successful Replay Result records an independently verified Validator Capability binding rather than relying on a self-reported capability or version string.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result lacks independent Validator Capability verification.
Validator version text alone establishes capability trust.
oracle.observable: Replay Result binding record and the independent Validator Capability verification outcome.

acceptance.then: Validator Capability is independently verified for that successful Replay Result.
acceptance.when: The replay selector evaluates a successful Replay Result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the successful-replay selector with the independent Validator Capability binding removed or substituted.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require each successful Replay Result to bind independently verified Validator Capability content and dependencies before success is retained.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve replay-result compatibility while rejecting successful results whose Validator Capability binding is not independently established.

slice_hint.state_transition: Successful Replay Result without independently established Validator Capability -> successful Replay Result carrying an independently verified capability binding.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The selector accepts a successful Replay Result only when its independent Validator Capability verification is recorded and rejects missing, substituted, self-reported, or version-only capability evidence.

acceptance.given: The frozen historical repository-relative path inventory and the current repair working tree are available for comparison.

oracle.expected: The repository-relative path comparison reports no renamed, relocated, or rewritten historical paths after repair evaluation.
oracle.observable: Deterministic before/after repository-relative path inventory comparison performed during repair validation.

acceptance.when: Repair validation compares the frozen path inventory with the current repository state.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the historical path-integrity selector after a rename, relocation, or rewrite of a frozen repository-relative path.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Preserve frozen repository-relative path identities and reject repair validation when the before/after path inventory differs.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No repository-relative path migration is permitted; historical path identities remain compatible and unchanged.

slice_hint.state_transition: Frozen repository-relative path inventory -> compared current inventory with identical historical path identities.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The path-integrity selector reports equality for the frozen and current repository-relative path inventories and fails on any rename, relocation, or rewrite.

acceptance.given: A fresh checkout has the pinned inputs and pinned Exact Cover graph available for reconstruction.

oracle.expected: The reconstructed Exact Cover graph equals the pinned graph and contains no unexplained orphan Atomic Obligation, assertion, selector, command, witness, or runtime-evidence node.
forbidden: Reporting reproduction when the Exact Cover graph differs from the pinned graph.
Hiding orphan obligations, assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, or runtime evidence through aggregate counts or labels.
oracle.observable: The fresh-replay Exact Cover graph comparison and bidirectional orphan check.

acceptance.then: Exact Cover equality and completeness are verified from fresh replay evidence.
acceptance.when: Fresh replay completes Exact Cover verification after reconstructing the pinned input identities.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the fresh-replay Exact Cover selector with a pinned-graph mismatch or orphan-node mutation and observe rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Rebuild the original pinned Exact Cover binding before fresh replay, compare the rebuilt graph bidirectionally with the pinned graph, and reject any mismatch or orphan node.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay receipt and Exact Cover schema compatibility; a mismatch remains a failed reproduction.

slice_hint.state_transition: Pinned Exact Cover exists but has not been freshly reproduced -> original binding is rebuilt -> fresh replay verifies graph equality and orphan freedom.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Fresh replay reports Exact Cover equality and no unexplained orphan nodes; otherwise reproduction is rejected.

acceptance.given: Validator Capability evaluation is prepared with a current candidate and an authority-path trust-envelope input.

oracle.expected: Before evaluation, the existing authority path emits a candidate-external trust envelope whose canonical record contains validator content identity, the complete Semantic Dependency identities, support policy, and scope; evaluation accepts it only when every required member is present, unambiguous, and unchanged.
forbidden: The Candidate change set creates, selects, or controls the trust envelope.
Evaluation starts without a pre-evaluation frozen trust envelope.
A missing, ambiguous, or changed validator, dependency, support-policy, or scope member is accepted as valid.
oracle.observable: The replay receipt and persisted envelope record show the frozen validator content, complete dependency identities, support policy, scope, authority provenance, and pre-evaluation timestamp/order; mutating, removing, or ambiguously duplicating any member causes deterministic validation rejection before evaluation.

acceptance.then: The trust envelope is frozen and verified before any candidate evaluation process executes.
acceptance.when: Prepare and execute Validator Capability evaluation, then repeat with each envelope member removed, duplicated ambiguously, or content/dependency/policy/scope changed.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove the pre-evaluation trust-envelope artifact and assert that evaluation refuses to start.
Make the candidate change set supply or alter the envelope authority/content and assert candidate-external trust validation rejects it.
Delete, ambiguously duplicate, or mutate one validator-content, semantic-dependency, support-policy, or scope member and assert the envelope is invalidated before evaluation.

affected_subjects: Validator trust envelope lifecycle and pre-evaluation Semantic Dependency binding
slice_hint.behavior_change: Make the Toolchain replay authority path construct and freeze a candidate-external trust envelope containing validator content, complete Semantic Dependency identities, support policy, and scope, and fail closed before evaluation when any member is missing, ambiguous, or changed.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay route and receipt compatibility; rollback restores prior envelope validation behavior while retaining append-only evidence and rejecting candidate-controlled authority.

slice_hint.state_transition: No evaluation may transition to running until a frozen, candidate-external, closure-complete trust envelope is independently verified; any member drift transitions the attempt to deterministic rejection.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Evaluation reaches a terminal rejected state with an explicit trust-envelope invalidation reason whenever the envelope is absent, candidate-controlled, incomplete, ambiguous, or changed; only a complete unchanged envelope permits evaluation to proceed.
